label: Some actually contingent fact has no admitted complete-ground…, by Typed deductive composition
meaning: Consume existing ExplanatoryAdequacy.forced on an explicit R-reason projection. Under WF, an actually contingent member with only noncontingent predecessors cannot admit any candidate complete-ground set: actual members would all be boxed true, and joint sufficiency would contradict that member’s accessible failure. Explicit EM extracts the existential; no stronger ReasonClosed/nonCopy/coverage hypothesis.
